position: Reports directed to the Department of Education and other agencies
proposal: The Mandate recommends that the next President issue a series of executive orders requiring: an accounting of how federal programs and grants spread DEI, critical race theory and gender ideology; a review of outcomes for GEAR UP and the 21st Century grants; a reissue of the 2018 school safety report with updated information; a report to Congress on consolidating the Department and trimming nonessential employees; a report on action civics; an update of the Coleman report on family structure and student achievement; a full accounting of CARES Act education expenditures; and a report on how many dollars reach the classroom in each federal education grant and program (pp. 358 to 359).

status_summary: Two executive orders in 2025 direct internal reporting that overlaps the first item: Executive Order 14151 (signed 2025-01-20) requires agency heads to give OMB lists of DEI-related programs and grantees within 60 days, and Executive Order 14190 (signed 2025-01-29) requires an Ending Indoctrination Strategy, including a summary and analysis of federal funding streams supporting gender ideology or discriminatory equity ideology in K-12, within 90 days. Executive Order 14242 (signed 2025-03-20) directs the Secretary to facilitate closing the Department and requires no report. The FY2027 request provides no funding for GEAR UP or 21st Century Community Learning Centers, but no outcome review, reissued school safety report, action civics report, Coleman update, CARES accounting or classroom-dollars report was found.

timeline.event: Executive Order 14151 was signed (published 2025-01-29, document 2025-01953); section 2(b)(ii) requires each agency head to give the OMB Director, within 60 days, lists of DEI, DEIA and environmental justice positions, programs and expenditures, DEI training contractors and grantees.

Executive Order 14190 (Ending Radical Indoctrination in K-12 Schooling) was signed (published 2025-02-03, document 2025-02232); section 3 requires the Secretaries of Education, Defense and Health and Human Services to submit within 90 days an Ending Indoctrination Strategy with a summary and analysis of federal funding streams supporting gender ideology or discriminatory equity ideology in K-12.

Executive Order 14242 (Improving Education Outcomes by Empowering Parents, States, and Communities) was signed (published 2025-03-25, document 2025-05213); section 2 directs the Secretary to take all necessary steps to facilitate closure of the Department and sets no report to Congress or deadline.

The FY2027 President's budget request for the Department of Education provides no funding for GEAR UP (FY2025: $388 million) or 21st Century Community Learning Centers (FY2025: about $1.33 billion). (month only; first of month used)

title: Executive orders requiring education program reports, reviews and accountings
uncertainties: Element by element, found: DEI accounting directed (EO 14151 section 2(b)(ii), EO 14190 section 3); GEAR UP and 21st Century eliminated in the FY2027 request (a budget proposal, not an outcome review). Not found: reissued school safety report, action civics report, Coleman update, CARES Act accounting directed by an order, classroom-dollars report, and a report to Congress on consolidation. Searches run (five): school safety report reissue, ESSER and CARES accounting reports, action civics, Coleman report update, McMahon report to Congress; results were commentary, state pages and older material, so absence rests on a limited search. Whether the 60-day and 90-day submissions under EO 14151 and EO 14190 were delivered or published was not established. The orders were read through fetch summaries of the Federal Register pages, and their numbers, signing dates and publication dates were confirmed there. The FY2027 release is dated April 2026; a law-firm summary gives 2026-04-03. The reviewer re-read Executive Orders 14151, 14190 and 14242 on the Federal Register and the FY2027 table, and ran no searches for this record. Whether the 21st Century program is folded into a consolidated K-12 program was not confirmed in the table read. A bill introduced 2026-07-09 (H.R. 9610) would transfer Department functions, which is relevant to c11-01 and c11-02 rather than to a report. Department inspector general audits of pandemic funds appeared in results and were not opened.
